basic_info.description: 1475-77 5th Avenue resides on one of the prettiest blocks in the Inner Sunset. This home has location, scale, flexibility, and great outdoor space. Checking all the boxes: large entertaining rooms, including a gracious entry that leads you to both the formal living room and dining room; a study off the dining room, a sunny, eat-in kitchen with an adjacent powder room and direct access to a large inviting deck and backyard; 4 bedrooms and two full baths on one floor; and an office nook off the primary bedroom; and a one car garage. PLUS, there is a permitted one bedroom, one bath unit with a private entrance and its own deck. A great au pair unit, extended family suite or an income unit. 1475-77 5th Avenue is 1 block from transportation, 2 blocks from coffee, 3 blocks from the park, and 5 blocks from 9th & Irving.
